It runs from source (arm64 + amd64), has the planted alert bug, the connection leak, the over-broad IAM policy, a 3-hour box, and a 4-area rubric scored 0–3; `hiring/` is deleted from the infra branch.

- [décision] No pass threshold; scores are input, the panel decides, Noa is 2nd reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] Exercise kept in its own private repo; no PR in infra, `hiring/` deleted from the branch (source: t14)
- [prochaine-étape] You send the exercise yourself after the call, Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv time; nothing is emailed, the repo awaits your collaborator invite (source: t16)
